{{Quote|We caught them with their shields down. Everything is proceeding as you predicted, Admiral.|Captain Shantillen to Admiral Krion Grail|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
'''Shantillen''' served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] at the time of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. By [[137 ABY]], Shantillen was stationed aboard the [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]] [[Marauder (Ardent-class)|''Marauder'']] and was assigned to the [[First Coruscant Task Force]], as the second in command to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Krion Grail]].<ref name="Legacy 42" />
